reason: A is the better proposal because dilute B grain-boundary segregation is a physically credible route to improve cohesion in brittle intermetallic alloys and is less likely than 2 wt% Nb precipitation to perturb the composition-sensitive caloric transition. B’s assumed coherent Nb-rich grain-boundary precipitates are poorly justified and could instead embrittle boundaries, although both proposals lack explicit operating boundaries, supporting evidence, and rigorous quantitative falsification criteria.
